mechanism_of_action: Long-acting Fc-FGF21 fusion protein; FGF21 is described as anti-fibrotic and as improving metabolic status.
primary_endpoint: Absolute change from baseline in hepatic fat fraction measured by MRI-PDFF at week 12.
efficacy_outcome: At week 12, HFF changed by −12.3%, −13.4%, and −14.1% with efruxifermin 28, 50, and 70 mg, respectively, versus +0.3% with placebo (P<0.0001 for each dose vs placebo).
safety_signal: Among 79 patients receiving study drug, 70 (89%) had at least one TEAE; 64 (81%) had grade 1–2, five (6%) grade 3, and one grade 4. The most common drug-related TEAEs were grade 1–2 gastrointestinal events (36; 46%).
